lines.en: I advance by hopping.
I flatten when I land.
I bounce up and fall again.
My body wobbles.
I hop over a brick.

lines.zh: 我留下一片金色的湿痕
lines.en: I leave a golden smear.
Each hop goes higher.
I rolled, then sprang up.
I bounce toward you.
I do not walk; I bounce.
My edges trail threads.
I land with a sticky sound.
One hop crosses half the yard.
My surface reflects light.
My bounces are not accurate.
One more hop and I arrive.
I spread out flat on the ground.
Something turns slowly inside me.
My surface trembles.

lines.zh: 我像一摊会呼吸的金子
lines.en: I look like breathing gold.
I have no need of legs at all.
I wait for something to touch me.
My gold is dazzling.
I slowly gather back into a round.

lines.zh: 我用整个身体感觉地面
lines.en: I feel the floor with all of me.
I keep away from fire.
I am slowly rising.
I'm counting the flecks of light that fall in.
You smell of metal.
I flatten toward you.

lines.zh: 你踩过的地面我都记得
lines.en: I remember every floor you stepped on.
This puddle is all of me.
Do not poke me with that sword.
You're still two steps from me.
Move back a little.
You carry my color now.
We are about the same height.
Move once and I will know.
A chunk of me caved in.
I drew back a layer.
I do not cry; I only quiver.
Your weapon sank in.
I slowly swell back.
That made me thinner.
A small gold piece fell off.
I remember that direction.
This puddle of me remains.
Poke again and see.
Does that smell of gold?
I do not swallow food.
Hold it that high and I can't reach.
I only want the piece by your feet.
This will not melt into me.
Holding it up does nothing.
Let me slide over and try.
Let me wrap it a while first.
I do not eat, but I want it.
Please step to one side.
You stepped right into me.
I wrapped your boot.
I sank and sprang.
You got stuck for a moment.
There are no bones in this puddle.
Our contact was sticky.
It took two shakes to free yourself.
I drew myself back a little.
My edge still clings to your foot.
Watch your step when you walk.
You lost your footing on me.
You flattened me.
Your foot slipped.
I creep up your leg.
We multiply by dividing instead.
Gold needs no companion.
You are asking something odd.
I only become more of myself.
I never learned such things.
Do not put your foot down.
I spread flatter.
I am a crowd on my own.
Get away from this puddle.
I only want floor.
I have wrapped it up completely.
It sank into me.
You can no longer see it.
This thing is far too heavy.
I push it back out.
It is coated in gold now.
I am giving it back to you.
I won't fight you for that fleck of gold.
I do not want to touch it at all.
It makes me heavier.
Your foot sank into me.
Then it is you I pick.
I start bouncing your way.
My aim is to touch you.
My gold is on your soles now.
I bounce slowly, but I do not stop.
I have touched you once already.
You will remember this color.
I flattened myself out.
I am bouncing over to you.
I follow hop by hop.
You went up the steps.
I cannot bounce up that high.
I wait below.
You will have to come down eventually.
My gold shines even in the dark.
Do you hear the sticky sound?
Hop by hop, I close in.
Three steps of yours, one hop of mine.
I am always where you land.
I lunge and wrap you.
No pain in this, only stickiness.
You were dragged half a block.
My touch is the harm.
You cannot shake me off at all.
My surface is tightening.
Your leg is coated in gold.
I press another layer onto you.
Your heel pulls a thread of gold.

lines.zh: 我的金边裹住你的靴口
lines.en: My gold rim wraps your boot top.
I spread out on the ground.
A golden puddle appeared here.
I was in the floor's seams all along.
My surface lit first.
I gathered into a lump.
Did you hear the dripping?
This patch of ground is mine now.
I am a drop of gold that gathered itself.
I seeped out of the brickwork.
I rose by your feet.
Fire hardened my surface.
I splattered out flat.
Water thins me into a film.
The blast spattered me on the wall.
The arrow went through and my gold closed over it.
The spell dulled my gold.
I keep thinning.
Lightning made my surface brittle.

lines.zh: 这里没有地面可以摊开
lines.en: There is no floor to spread on.
